definition: n. 行为; 品行 v. 引导; 管理; 指挥(乐队); 传导
example: The scientists conducted a series of experiments. (科学家进行了一系列实验。)

definition: n. 传导; 传热
example: Metals are good at heat conduction. (金属善于传热。)

definition: n. 管理者; (汽车)售票员; 领队; 指挥; 导体
example: Copper is a good conductor of electricity. (铜是电的良导体。)

definition: n. 锥体; 锥形
example: Traffic cones were placed on the road. (路上放置了交通锥。)

definition: v. 协商; 授予
example: The committee conferred with the experts. (委员会与专家进行了协商。)

definition: n. (正式)会议; 讨论; 商谈
example: He is attending an international conference. (他正在参加一个国际会议。)

definition: v. 供认; 承认; 坦白; 忏悔
example: He confessed to the crime. (他承认了罪行。)

definition: n. 供认; 自由
example: The police obtained a signed confession. (警方获得了一份签署的供词。)

definition: v. 委托; 吐露秘密
example: She confided her troubles to her best friend. (她向最好的朋友倾诉了烦恼。)

definition: n. (in)信任; 信心; 自信; 秘密; 机密
example: I have every confidence in your ability. (我对你的能力充满信心。)

definition: a. 确信的; 有把握的
example: She is confident that she will pass the exam. (她确信自己能通过考试。)

definition: a. 秘(机)密的; 表示信任的; 担任机密工作的
example: Please keep this information confidential. (请对这些信息保密。)

definition: n. 构造; 结构; 配置; 外形
example: We changed the configuration of the office furniture. (我们改变了办公家具的布局。)

definition: vt. 限制; 禁闭
example: Please confine your remarks to the topic. (请将你的发言限制在主题范围内。)

definition: n. 限制
example: He spent years in solitary confinement. (他在单独监禁中度过了数年。)

definition: vt. 证实; 确定; 批准
example: Please confirm your reservation by email. (请通过电子邮件确认您的预订。)

definition: n. 证实; 确定; 确认
example: We are waiting for confirmation of the deal. (我们在等待交易的确认。)

definition: n. 战斗; 斗争; (意见)分歧; vi. 抵触; 冲突
example: The two countries are in conflict over territory. (两国在领土问题上存在冲突。)

definition: n. 汇合
example: The city was built at the confluence of two rivers. (这座城市建在两条河流的交汇处。)

definition: v. 符合; 遵从
example: The building does not conform to safety regulations. (这座建筑不符合安全规定。)

definition: n. 遵照; 一致
example: They acted in conformity with the law. (他们依法行事。)

definition: vt. 使面对; 面临
example: We must confront the reality of the situation. (我们必须面对现实情况。)

definition: n. 面对; 对峙
example: They want to avoid a direct confrontation. (他们想避免直接对抗。)

definition: vt. 使困惑; 混淆
example: Don't confuse austria with australia. (不要把奥地利和澳大利亚混淆了。)

definition: n. 困惑; 糊涂; 混淆; 混乱; 骚乱
example: There was a lot of confusion after the announcement. (公告发布后，一片混乱。)

definition: adj. 拥挤的
example: The streets are heavily congested during rush hour. (高峰时段街道非常拥挤。)

definition: n. 拥挤; 混杂
example: Traffic congestion is a major problem in the city. (交通拥堵是城市的一大问题。)

definition: v. (on)祝贺; 向...致贺词
example: I congratulated him on his success. (我祝贺他的成功。)

definition: n. (on)祝贺; (pl.)祝贺词
example: Congratulations on your wedding! (祝贺你新婚快乐！)

definition: v. 聚集
example: People congregated in the town square. (人们聚集在城镇广场上。)

definition: n. 代表会议; (C-)(美国等)议会
example: Congress passed the new bill. (国会通过了新法案。)

definition: n. 国会议员
example: The congressman voted against the proposal. (这位国会议员投票反对该提案。)

definition: adj. 适合的
example: His actions are congruent with his principles. (他的行为与他的原则一致。)

definition: n. 连词; 联合; 连接
example: The police worked in conjunction with the army. (警方与军队联合行动。)

definition: vt. 连接; 与...联系; 接通(电话)vi. 连接
example: This road connects the two villages. (这条路连接着两个村庄。)
